name: Form
summary: A labelled, validated set of fields — sign-in, settings, create dialogs — rendered through the shared Form.
lead: Form carries layout, validation, and every control it hosts — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared formTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

props.name: fields
props.desc: name / label / rules / control per row

whenToUse.when: two or more related fields submitted together, with validation
one value that applies on its own — no submit step
a settings surface — see the Settings pattern for grouping and spacing

opinion.note: Label every field with a noun phrase above the control (vertical layout reads best on narrow surfaces). Validate on blur and on submit; show the error below the field with how to fix it. One primary submit per form.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared formTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (formTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 input + primary button bound to formTheme.
